question: Clutch 1v2 post-plant A Site Split, spike planted, 30s. You are Omen on site, 1 DEF spotted descending from A Heaven (high-ground), 1 unknown. How do you clutch?

options.label: Dark Cover (smoke) under A Heaven to cut the high-ground, isolate the low-ground DEF, and duel them sequentially
options.explication_courte: In a 1v2 never fight both at once; on Split the main danger is the vertical Heaven threat. Smoke the high-ground, duel the low DEF first, then re-clear Heaven.

options.label: Paranoia toward the site entry to blind the incoming DEF and take a duel through the flash
options.explication_courte: Paranoia buys tempo and can blind an angle, but it does not cover the vertical Heaven threat; against a DEF descending from above, you remain exposed.

sources_option.citation: A blind (Paranoia) buys tempo and space but does not cover a vertical high-ground angle; against an elevated defender it can miss the overhead threat.

options.label: Shrouded Step (teleport) to flank and catch the DEF from an unexpected angle
options.explication_courte: Teleport-flanking in a 1v2 takes you away from the spike and exposes you to both DEF in motion: you lose track of the defuse and your positioning.

sources_option.citation: Abandoning the plant to flank in a clutch exposes you to both defenders while giving up defuse denial; the teleport audio also reveals your reposition.

options.label: Peek A Heaven directly to kill the spotted DEF before they descend
options.explication_courte: Peeking Heaven directly exposes you to the second unknown DEF who can instantly trade: you fight both simultaneously on the most telegraphed angle on the map.

sources_option.citation: Peeking a known high-ground defender on Split without accounting for the second player exposes you to an instant trade; never fight two at once in a clutch.

explication_longue:
Situation: 1v2 clutch post-plant on A Site Split, spike planted, 30 seconds. You are Omen with Dark Cover, Paranoia, Shrouded Step; 1 DEF spotted descending from A Heaven, 1 unknown.

Core 1v2 principle: never fight both defenders simultaneously - isolate one 1v1 at a time. On Split, A Heaven is the defining high-ground: a DEF descending from above has a vertical angle you cannot peek without exposing yourself to the unknown second DEF at ground level.

Optimal sequence: smoke under A Heaven to cut the high-ground line (no vertical threat), duel the low-ground DEF first with the isolated angle, then deal with the Heaven DEF once you have numbers parity. Paranoia (acceptable) buys tempo but does not solve the vertical Heaven problem. Shrouded Step flanking (costly) takes you away from the spike and puts you between two moving defenders. Peeking Heaven directly (mistake) fights both defenders at once on the most obvious angle.

Estimated elite distribution: ~54% smoke Heaven + sequential duels, ~22% Paranoia entry, ~16% Shrouded Step flank (costly), ~6% direct Heaven peek (mistake).

sources.citation: Split rewards controlling vertical angles like Heaven; in a clutch, cutting the high-ground sightline with a smoke isolates duels and prevents facing two players at once.
Smokes are the clutch tool to isolate an angle and reduce a 1vX to a series of 1v1s; blinds buy tempo but do not cover elevated positions.
In a post-plant clutch the clock is on the planter's side; hold the spike, isolate duels, and avoid repositions that expose you to multiple defenders.

_gaps.incertitude: Estimations depuis guides Split + util (exitlag, boosteria, dignitas) ; la frequence smoke-isolate vs Paranoia depend du read sur la position du 2e DEF, sans dataset public.
La position du 2e DEF est inconnue (design) ; si les deux DEF sont groupes au sol, la valeur du smoke sous Heaven baisse — ce que trancherait un juge.
Positions x/y approximatives sur A Site Split (viewBox 1000x1000, zones de maps.ts) ; le surplomb A Heaven est un attribut vertical non geometrise dans le token 2D.
